newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq drops further, but computer stocks firm.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq drops further, but computer stocks firm.

text.p: Nasdaq shares dropped for the fourth consective session on Tuesday after a weekly economic report spooked an already nervous market, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index lost 10.51 points, or 0.66 percent, to close unofficially at 1576.23. Nasdaq shares traded in a relatively wide 25 point range, showing gains until the afternoon when a weekly retail sales report gave both stocks and bonds a jolt, traders said.
The sell-off wiped away gains in several major technology issues, but computer makers still finished strong.
"They tried to rally a couple times today, but without much luck," said Jack Bayer, managing director and head over-the-counter trader with Oppenheimer & Co.
"We could have more of this behavior tomorrow," Bayer said, referring to the market's potential reaction to key economic reports expected Wednesday.

Apple Computer Inc lost 2-8/16 to 22-1/16 after it said it sees another loss for the fiscal fourth quarter ending in September. Amgen Inc, the most active Nasdaq issue, dropped 12 percent after it forecast lower-than- expected sales of its key Epogen drug in the second half of the year.
